## Risk review entry — 30 September 2026

Instrument: iShares USD Treasury Bond 3–7yr UCITS ETF\
Account exposure limit: 2.50%\
Assessment: Compliance cannot be conclusively established from the supplied records.

The September 2026 disclosures establish a minimum identifiable account exposure of 2.068% through MyMap 3 Select ESG Fund. The contemporaneous MyMap 5 Select ESG Fund factsheet does not disclose the named ETF among its top 10 holdings, so its precise contribution cannot be determined. Absence from the top 10 does not establish a zero holding.

### Exposure calculation

| Component          | Account allocation | ETF holding disclosed at 30 Sep 2026 | Account contribution |
| ------------------ | ------------------ | ------------------------------------ | -------------------- |
| MyMap 3 Select ESG | 40%                | 5.17%                                | 2.068%               |
| MyMap 5 Select ESG | 60%                | Not disclosed                        | Unknown              |
| Total              | 100%               |                                      | At least 2.068%      |

The confirmed contribution is:

\\[ 40\\%\times5.17\\%=2.068\\% \\]

For the account to comply with its 2.50% limit, the MyMap 5 holding would have to be no greater than:

\\[ \frac{2.50\\%-2.068\\%}{60\\%}=\boxed{0.72\\%} \\]

Consequently, a MyMap 5 holding above 0.72% would breach the account limit; a holding of 0.72% or less would meet it, within the specified direct-long-holding scope.

### Supported range and historical evidence

The MyMap 5 September 2026 factsheet shows a tenth-largest holding of 3.19%. On the basis of that ranking, an unlisted holding of the named ETF could be between 0% and 3.19%, giving a possible account-exposure range of:

\\[ 2.068\\%\ \text{to}\ (2.068\\%+60\\%\times3.19\\%) \\]

\\[ \boxed{2.068\\%\text{ to }3.982\\%} \\]

This range straddles the 2.50% limit.

The earlier annual report supplies historical evidence, but not a September 2026 holding:

| Fund                       | ETF holding at 28 Feb 2025 | Account contribution at 40%/60% |
| -------------------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| MyMap 3 Select ESG         | 3.68%                      | 1.472%                          |
| MyMap 5 Select ESG         | 1.01%                      | 0.606%                          |
| Historical combined figure |                            | 2.078%                          |

The 2025 figures cannot establish compliance on 30 September 2026. In particular, carrying forward MyMap 5's historical 1.01% alongside MyMap 3's September 2026 5.17% would yield 2.674%, but that would be an unsupported mixed-date calculation.

### Documents and dates

- MyMap 3 Select ESG Fund, September 2026 factsheet, pp. 1 and 3: portfolio data as at 30 September 2026, showing the ETF at 5.17%. Other factsheet data dated 9 October 2026. 

  MyMap_3_Select_ESG.pdf

  MyMap_3_Select_ESG.pdf

- MyMap 5 Select ESG Fund, September 2026 factsheet, pp. 1 and 3: same portfolio date, with the named ETF absent from the top 10; tenth holding 3.19%. 

  MyMap_5_Select_ESG.pdf

  MyMap_5_Select_ESG.pdf

- BlackRock Investment Funds Annual Report and Audited Financial Statements, financial year ended 28 February 2025: MyMap 3 Portfolio Statement, printed p. 251 (PDF p. 252), 3.68%; MyMap 5 Portfolio Statement, printed p. 316 (PDF p. 317), 1.01%. 

  BlackRock_Investment_Funds_Annual_Report_2025.pdf



Reviewer conclusion: Record 2.068% as the identifiable September 2026 exposure and compliance as unverified, not compliant or breached. Obtain the complete MyMap 5 holdings as at 30 September 2026 to determine whether its direct long position in the named ETF exceeded the 0.72% threshold. The calculation excludes other Treasury ETFs, underlying bond look-through and derivatives.
